description: Shared Renovate preset for stevehansen repos.
Non-major updates land as one weekly grouped PR that Renovate merges once every status check is green; repos without CI keep it open for a manual merge.
Majors stay separate PRs for review. Security fixes (from Dependabot alerts) ignore the schedule and release-age wait.
platformAutomerge is off because these repos have no branch protection, so GitHub-native automerge cannot wait on CI.
